production_conclusion.classification: Existing intended behavior meets parent-provided Leave-confirmation exclusion policy at source level. Preserve behavior; add verification and comments rather than manufacturing a rule change.
complete_path: SessionDrivenFlow exitConfirmationOpen substitutes SessionExitConfirmation for paused/router branches, keeping authoritative controller and SerializedSnapshotWriter alive.
HostSessionFlow leaveConfirmationOpen substitutes confirmation for multiplayer presentation; retained WhodunitHostRuntime owns canonical controller/bridge but contains no timer loop.
Only RoundSegment LaunchedEffect(timerId,session) invokes runDiscussionTickerLoop, and only when session.hostState != null. Removal cancels it at cooperative delay; peer shadows never execute it.
Stay clears confirmation boolean only. New ticker starts with fresh delay from unchanged canonical remaining seconds; no elapsed-time catch-up and no unconditional Resume action.
Host bridge lifecycle collects Suspended/Resuming/Active and tracks pausedByAppLifecycle; pre-existing manual pause is not claimed as lifecycle-owned.

review_findings.problem: Pinned Skiko runComposeUiTest rejects nonempty effectContext; all4 host tests fail before application content mounts.
review_findings.evidence: First-cycle host XML IllegalArgumentException at SkikoComposeUiTest constructor164. Fresh official1.10.3 source download independently verifies exact guard.
review_findings.remediation: Use supported default effect context and explicitly coordinate host scheduler with Compose clock. Do not change production or upgrade API to bypass.

review_findings.problem: PauseOverlay renders title through EyebrowLabel.uppercase(); Text selector Paused cannot match PAUSED. Pane title is distinct semantics.
review_findings.evidence: First-cycle local paused test timeout at awaitGame197; PauseOverlay84,117–120 and EyebrowLabel17 form complete source proof.
review_findings.remediation: Match actual text or correct pane semantics; do not change production wording.

review_findings.problem: Failure is injected only after canonical snapshot already persisted. Writer correctly deduplicates equal state; flush succeeds without another storage call, so test cannot witness failed save.
review_findings.evidence: First-cycle timeout at attempts counter; SerializedSnapshotWriter55–56 equality early return.
review_findings.remediation: Inject before a real state change, observe failed attempt on current snapshot, distinguish last durable data from attempted current data, then verify retry stores the unchanged frozen current snapshot.

review_findings.classification: TEST RELIABILITY RISK — source-proven scheduling independence; not a demonstrated app bug
review_findings.problem: Latest durable snapshot read immediately after virtual-time jump may lag because writeContext is real Dispatchers.Default. Virtual advancement does not await actual persistence.
review_findings.evidence: Source dispatch boundary plus atomic latest updated only on storage completion; not a green/run failure proof.
review_findings.remediation: Await exact expected durable/attempted snapshot under a bounded real wait without ticking virtual time, then assert invariants.
